lines.en: slanted door, o slanted door — angled like the dutch
a lock to keep the thieves away, a hole to see as such
so when that knockingbird does knock, i hope that you’ll be smart
for open doors are dangerous, like girls with broken hearts
hello, my name is JOSEPH and i will be your narrator for the beginning of this event since half of the others are still stuck on the beach i think
so anyway yeah, chika chosokabe had been having a pretty rough go of it lately. but i’m sure you already know that.

in fact, right now, she was doing a search on her phone about which acids best dissolve bodies so that, should she encounter that terrible harlot she thought was boning her boyf, she’d know what to do.
just kidding. she was looking up concert tickets to try and get her mind off of the fact that the man she deceived herself into believing was loyal was actually a big old manslut.
just kidding again. she was still poor, so she was just texting rin.
just kidding again again. she was playing candy crush.
: Chinami, I’m home.
: Welcome home, big sis Chika! Yumi brought Chinami a present!
that’s all the narration you’re going to get about chika though because this is actually a yumi event.
: Bought? Or stole?
ooooh sick burn.
okay i’m done for real now.
: Ha ha ha, very funny. But I guess this thing was practically stolen on account of how friggin’ cheap it was.
: Mhm. So, what are you doing here exactly?
: I’m off today, which is a thing you’d probably know if you remembered how to look at your phone. Been callin’ you nonstop for days and I ain’t heard shit.
: Big sis Yumi used a bad word! Now she has to stand still and let Chinami kick her in the teeth!
: Go ahead, loser. I practiced against Noriko for like three hours yesterday and I’m pretty much a pro at this now.
: Was Noriko busy today too? Is that why you’re here?
: The hell’s your problem? Tough day at your little con-factory?
: Big sis Yumi is vulnerable! Chinami will have victory!
: Not if I have anything to do about it, twerp!
: Rats! Big sis Yumi is too good at blocking! She should fight Chinami like a real man!
: It ain’t fair if I don’t give ya a chance, you know? Bring it, kid!
: Quickly if you can, Chinami. I’m about to make dinner and I only have enough for two.
: It’s whatever. I’ll just crash on the futon while you guys eat. I don’t feel like stayin’ at the old place tonight. Too far.
: Well, that sucks for you because you aren’t welcome here anymore.
: What? Why? Rich girl gettin’ stingy with the leasing agreement or something? Was only a matter of time. They’re all like that.
: No, Touka’s been an angel. I just don’t want you here anymore.
: ...What?
: Did...big sis Yumi do something bad again?
: I don’t know. Did you do something bad, Yumi?
: Uhh...I don’t know. Probably? But I ain’t really got an idea of anything I did that’d piss you off this much, so...wanna maybe fill me in?
: Not really. I kind of just want you to get out of here so I can make dinner.
: What are you-
: B...Big sis? I think you’re supposed to...give someone an explanation when you’re mad at them...
: That’s right, Chinami. But if you’re friends with someone and that supposed friend stabs you in the back, you don’t owe them an explanation. So there are exceptions to the rule.
: Hold on, hold on, hold on!
: The fuck is this shit about-
: Language.
: Nah, I ain’t got time for that right now. The fuck is this shit about stabbin’ you in the back? You’re like the one person I’m consistently good to.
: Chinami, cover your ears please. If Yumi’s going to use bad words, I’m going to as well. And you shouldn’t have to hear that.
: Ch-Chinami is sure this is all one big misunderstanding! And she’d be really happy if everybody could just get along so-
: Chinami! Earmuffs.
: But...big sis Yumi would never do anything bad to us. She might use bad words, but she’s a good person. She-
: She’s a spineless, backstabbing, self-serving bitch. That’s what she is. And she’s been taking advantage of our kindness for too long. So she’s not welcome anymore.
: This...This ain’t about money, is it? Because I can start payin’ you back for moochin’ off you for so long. I just figured the console was something that’d make the kid happy and-
: You really think I’d get pissed off about money? Me? Give me a fucking break. I’d have asked you to beg your dad for cash if I gave a single shit about that.
: Well, what the fuck is it then? Because I’ve got no idea what else I could’ve done that’d make you just suddenly friggin’ hate me overnight.
: You’ve got no clue I even know, do you?
: Know what?! I ain’t done shit! Least not...anything I’m aware of?!
: Mhm. So I guess you just forgot who my boyfriend is then. Fair enough. It’s not like I’ve been venting to you about him for months or anything.
: Your...boyfriend?
: Is that why you did it? You got tired of hearing me complain about not being able to see him and figured this might be a good way to shut me up? Or was all this happening before that?
: Chika...I don’t know what you heard, but I’m the last person you’ve gotta worry about when it comes to stealing your boyfriend.
: See, that’s what I thought too!
: Up until I saw the part where you two got all “up close and personal” on the beach in the middle of a fucking thunderstorm. Who do you think you are? Some love interest in a romantic drama?
: You...
: You saw that?
: Big sis Yumi...
: Did you really...
: Is that true?...
: N-No! I mean...yes! But no! It wasn’t what it looked like!
: Not what it looked like?! You asked to go back to his room! Do you want me to believe you two were playing chess?!
: You were more worried about someone seeing you than the fact that your knife was halfway into my spine! How could you do this to me?!
: O-Okay! How about we talk about this on the balcony? There’s clearly a fuckin’ major misunderstanding here and I don’t want to drag the kid into this.
: Yeah the balcony’s probably not the best idea either then.
: The glass is thick as hell. I’m sure it’ll be fine.
: Fine for Chinami, sure! But now you’re going to have to worry about me getting away with murder when I throw you over the fucking railing, whore!
: Chika! Chill the fuck out! Let me explain! It seriously wasn’t what it looked like!
: How gullible do you think I am?! I’ve been watching you closer than anyone! You’ve wanted to fuck him from the start! Don’t even pretend you haven’t!
: If I wanted to do that, I would have!
: So you admit that I mean nothing to you! You’ve been faking everything this whole fucking time!
: No! I mean I...uhh...well...
: Spit it the fuck out or someone’s going to be cleaning your guts off the fucking concrete, Yumi!
: It’s hard fucking finding words when you’re threatening my life, okay?! You’re freaking me the hell out! I’ll explain everything! I just...don’t want to die.
: You know, I should have seen this coming the second Sensei suggested you for my threesome present. I bet you felt so fucking smart rejecting that while getting dicked down on the side, didn’t you?
: Don’t blame me for your boyfriend being a fucking pervert. I have no idea why he suggested me. And I had no idea until you fucking told me about it.
: So it’s my fault then? And asking you to be a part of that special thing with me just made you thirsty? Is that it?
: Chika...no. I don’t look at him that way.
: You’re a fucking liar, Yumi. I know for a fact you look at him that way. I just figured it was one-sided and that you were a good enough friend to keep your fucking hands off of him for me.
: I trusted you. I’m the one person who has always had your back. Even when everyone else fucking abandoned you after the Nodoka thing, I fought for you. Literally.
: And this is my reward? Finding out you’ve been fucking my boyfriend while I break my back trying to figure out why he’s been avoiding me? How do you think that feels, Yumi? You proud of yourself?
: Just let me explain, Chika. It’s really not like that.
: I pray it’s not like that. Because...if it is? I don’t even know what I’m going to do to you.
: It’s...obviously true that you saw us together. But I wasn’t pretending to be some character in a “romantic drama” or whatever it is you said.
: It just...started raining and we wound up hiding in that fuckin’...closet or...whatever the hell it was. I don’t even remember.
: Probably because you were too busy staring deep into his eyes and saying stuff like, “Ohhh we shouldn’t! Someone might see!” The fuck did that mean if it’s not how it sounded, huh?
: Don’t fucking cry, pussy. Don’t go around wrecking homes if you aren’t prepared to face the consequences.
: That stuff...Chika...
: That...meant how it sounded. And yeah, I...maybe I got caught up in the...moment or something, but...I seriously wouldn’t do that to you...
: There was another line too. Something like...doing it once was already...something. Which very clearly implies shit already happened.
: So why not just go ahead and tell me how many times you fucked him that weekend? Now I’m just curious about whether or not you’ve broken my record.
: That...
: I’m a virgin, Chika. I’ve seriously never done that with him.
: Then what-
: I was...talking about...kissing.
: Kissing?...
: Do you think that makes this more forgivable?...
: It was before you two were even together! And I tried telling you about it, but...you were so fucking blinded by your feelings for the guy that I didn’t want to hurt you!
: I’m not buying it, Yumi. The more you speak, the more it’s starting to sound like this is some big ole’ convenient backstory you came up with in the event you got caught.
: At the end of the day, I saw you two curled up together. I heard you ask to go back to his room. And I’ve already had my suspicions about him.
: I just never thought in a million years it would be you I’d have to confront about it. You were like a sister to me.
: And...you’re like one to me. Which is exactly why I didn’t want to do anything to hurt you...
: Well, it’s very comforting to hear that the only thing preventing you from fucking my boyfriend is “how much you care about me.” But I’ve gotta say, Yumi — that’s not a great best-case scenario.
: Because even if everything you said is totally honest, which I highly doubt it is, you’ve still been hiding shit from me.
: I love him. You got that? In a way you never could and never will so long as I’m in the picture.
: And you want to know what’s really crazy? I’d still love him even if he fucked you a hundred times that night because you probably begged for it.
: You’re fucking delusional, Chika...
: I know that! I fucking know that already, Yumi! But no amount of mentally preparing myself and tricking myself into thinking I have a perfect relationship could have prepared me for this!
: Why didn’t you just tell me?! About the kiss?! About the storm?! About any of it?! I gave you plenty of time to try and salvage this and you did nothing!
: Bitch, I fucking tried to. But you’ve been ignoring me ever since the goddamn beach and now I know why.
: Right, well...that still doesn’t explain the kissing thing. And the going back to his room thing. And the millions of other things I’m mad at you about right now.
: And that’s...fair. You’re right in saying that even the best-case scenario sucks. But shouldn’t you be mad at him too? Not the gullible teenager who got swept up in the moment?
: I am mad at him! I’m mad at everyone! But there’s no one I’m madder at than myself for taking this long to figure it all out!
: As someone being held against a fuckin’ railing right now, I think I’m gonna have to say you’re a little bit madder at me than you are at yourself.
: As the person holding you against that fucking railing right now, I think I’m gonna ask you not to make jokes. This shit is unforgivable, Yumi. How would you feel if you were in my shoes?
: I don’t fuckin’ know, Chika...That’s just another reason why I try to stay away from all of this bullshit “romance” garbage. Shit’s just a tragedy waiting to happen.
: Well, unfortunately, we can’t all be aloof and heartless lone wolves like you.
: You at least gonna talk to him about it? Or will pushing me off of your fuckin’ balcony be all you need to get this shit out of your system?
: He’s next. Don’t worry.
: Can I be the one to call him over then?
: Why? Need some time to make sure you two have the same story?
: I’ll put it on fuckin’ speaker if you want. I don’t need to rehearse shit when everything I’ve said is the truth.
: And unless that douchebag plans on lying to you, which I wouldn’t put past him, he’ll tell you the same goddamn thing I did.
: Guess it won’t change shit even if he does though, right? Since it seems like you’ve already made up your mind about how much I fucking suck.
: I never meant to hurt you, Chika.
: I just ain’t good at havin’ feelings.
: Call him.
: Now?
: Now.
: Wow, what a nice day. I can’t wait for everything to turn to shit.
My phone begins to ring. And not a second too late.
: Hello?
: You need to get your fuckin’ ass to Chika’s place right now.
: Uhh...
: Why?
: Because she saw us on the beach and now thinks you’re cheating on her with me.
: Can you just come clear this up, please? I don’t know how to fuckin’ deal with her right now. And chances are I ain’t gonna be allowed here again for a long ass time, so...
: It’d be cool if you could try and set shit straight after all the fuckin’ torment you’ve inflicted on me these past however many school years it’s been.
: Give me the phone.
: Here’s Chika. Good luck.
: Hello?
: Are you coming over? Or are you going to run away like a little bitch just like you’ve been doing for months now?
: Yeah, I’m on my way.
: Cool. Here’s Yumi again.
: Bye.
Yumi hangs up the phone.
I don’t blame her.
I just feel bad for getting her involved in one more aspect of a life I never wanted.
Yumi’s affection has decreased by 10!
Chika’s affection has decreased by 10!
